card.title: Mia Megastar: Three Stories in One

metadata.description:
"Mia lives above Costa's, which everyone knows is the best shop for groceries and pastries.  She has a cute-but-annoying brother, Yianni, and the best friends ever. Oh, and her mum plays the worst pranks. Mia loves dancing and singing and is always putting on a show. This year, she gets closer to her dream of becoming a megastar, but the road to stardom has its dramas . . .  

The Mia Megastar series is perfect for kids aged eight-and-up dreaming of the stage. Fire up the souvla (that's the Greek barbecue, by the way) and join the Summerdale Stage Stars (Mia's drama club) on a journey of friendship, teamwork, family . . . and more than a few wacky dance moves."
